Hi Samira / IT team — Marissa on CS here, copying Lauren for scheduling coordination. Quick note from an ops perspective:

- Because Meet enforces organizer-auth for your domain, the safest approach is to use the Zoom fallback for external organizers. Zoom ICS works more reliably across SSO-enforced tenants.
- If your admins prefer to keep Meet, they can add redwood-demo@redwood.ai as an external calendar publisher/allowlist entry (Google Workspace admin setting), but that often takes 24+ hours.
- In the meantime we recommend attendees: add the Zoom link to calendar body and accept the invite; that keeps the event on calendars and avoids join-time friction.

Ben — could you please: 1) update the event subject to include "(Zoom fallback)"; 2) paste the Zoom join in the top of the calendar body; 3) resend the plain-email version to Samira's list so people without calendar rights can add it manually?

Samira — if you'd like, I can also host the meeting from a Redwood Zoom account so your admins can see it's not a guest host scenario (sometimes that helps).

Thanks — Marissa
